theorem_statement_short: For K in the bounded_return_full_core_delayed_gate_subclass, induced cylinder premeasure plus bounded entry/exit correction gives the lower transfer, and hence the delayed-return Bowen theorem closes.

lemmas.label: Induced cylinder premeasure construction
lemmas.statement_short: At the induced root, the product rule on return-block weights defines a consistent cylinder premeasure.

lemmas.label: Truncation-control lemma
lemmas.statement_short: Bounded entry/exit correction prevents exponential loss when transferring from induced cylinders to original cylinders.

lemmas.label: Return-to-original mass transfer lemma
lemmas.statement_short: The induced cylinder premeasure pushes forward to original cylinder pieces with bounded multiplicative loss.

lemmas.label: Lower content / ball comparison lemma
lemmas.statement_short: Usable overlap control converts the pushed-forward cylinder mass into a Frostman-style ball estimate.

lemmas.label: Lower-transfer theoremlet
lemmas.statement_short: The original attractor satisfies dim_H K >= s_* on the closed class.

lemmas.label: Final delayed-return Bowen closure
lemmas.statement_short: Combining the already-closed induced pressure/root step with LT-THM-5 gives dim_H K = s_* on the closed class.

gap_status: Lower transfer and final delayed-return Bowen closure are closed on the narrowed full-core subclass.

The remaining open issue is not theorem closure on the narrowed class, but whether the broader working class can be shown to satisfy full_core_induction and uniform_entry_exit_bound without narrowing.
